name: recorded-evidence-project-isolation
goal: Evidence and artifact requests keep one authorized repository when the selected project changes during a read.

evidence: A request must retain its authorized project context across awaits. A later project selection may not supply its source, history, identity or bytes.
Independent frozen test c53f17f3: two switch cases fail; two controls pass. Evidence returns project B and artifact mixes B history with A files. Red log 7cef9401 retained outside source.
Capture authorized root, source adapter and project ID once. Every awaited scope, identity and artifact step receives that immutable context.
Unchanged independent regression c53f17f3 passes all four cases. Durable relative-import copy is in the normal desktop suite; existing artifact and evidence tests are being checked.
